Definition: future of G1510; will be:--shall (should) be (have), (shall) come (to pass), X may have, X fall, what would follow, X live long, X sojourn.
BiblicalUsage: Ésomai is the word for 'will be' — the future of the verb to be. It is the tense of God's promise: 'I will be their God, and they shall be to me a people'. The word looks forward, and so does the covenant it carries.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ésomai is a word of promise, and I read every 'I will be' in Scripture as God staking His word on the future.
RelatedEvents: The Healing of the Demon-Possessed Boy
